name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 1.69 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
